work_order.approach: Take rejection option (a) live-truth and pin ONE calibration source for every live surface: the /journal panel and GET /v1/calibration are computed from the decisions repository via an evaluation outcome carried on the decision record itself. Extend validateDecisionRecord with an optional evaluation object {outcome: correct|incorrect, needless: boolean, evaluated_at: UTC ISO-8601} present only on matured decisions; live calibration math is precision = correct/evaluated and false-intervention = needless/interventions (selected_action != do_nothing) rounded to two decimals, with null rates (rendered as em-dash) when the denominator is zero. files.change: New pure module src/domain/decisions.js with: DECISION_CLASSES list; validateDecisionRecord(input) requiring decision_id (dec_ prefix), tenant_id, state_snapshot_id, decided_at UTC ISO-8601, alternatives array containing exactly one action do_nothing entry with non-empty reason plus at least one non-do-nothing alternative, expected_outcomes distributions as {mean,p10,p90} numbers, risk {expected_downside_micros integer, worst_reasonable_case string}, evidence_refs and memory_refs arrays, critic_result string, policy_decision_id string, model_versions and prompt_versions arrays, plus optional evaluation {outcome: correct|incorrect, needless: boolean, evaluated_at: UTC ISO-8601} allowed only alongside a matured decided_at and rejected otherwise; errors are {code,message,details} with stable codes MISSING_STATE_SNAPSHOT, MISSING_DO_NOTHING, BAD_DISTRIBUTION, INVALID_MONEY, BAD_EVALUATION. evaluationStatus(decision, nowIso): matured when nowIso >= expectedEvaluationAt else awaiting-maturity; expectedEvaluationAt = decided_at + 120h. Example computed: decided 2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z -> expected evaluation 2026-09-25T00:00:00.000Z. calibrationReport(decisionRows): LIVE aggregate over repository rows with an evaluation present: precision = correct/evaluated else null; falseInterventionRate = needless/interventions (selected_action != do_nothing) else null; both rounded to two decimals; returns {precision, falseInterventionRate, evaluated, correct, interventions, needless, awaitingMaturity}. Example computed (the pinned seed totals): evaluated=2 correct=2 -> precision 1.00; interventions=1 needless=0 -> 0.00; awaitingMaturity=1. Invariants: correct <= evaluated and needless <= interventions, all integers; every row without evaluation carries an expected evaluation date. frontierCheck(episode): hitting the CPL target returns keepProposing true and requires at least one do-nothing decision with reason. evaluateReplay(scenarios): folds frozen scenarios into the single AGGREGATE CI-only calibration report plus perScenario breakdown, imports nothing that can mutate (no executor, no policy kernel, no fetch, never imports test fixtures from src/), returns {precision, falseInterventionRate, evaluated, correct, interventions, needless, perScenario, mutationsExecuted: 0}.

Add migration 003_journal_tables creating state_snapshots (tenant_id, snapshot_id PRIMARY KEY per tenant, decided basis KPIs JSON, budgets JSON, funnel JSON, health JSON, memories JSON, created_at) and decisions (tenant_id, decision_id, state_snapshot_id, action_class, selected_action, record JSON including optional evaluation, decided_at, expected_evaluation_at, status) with BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers aborting on both tables (decisions append-only like raw_events; snapshots immutable), plus status index on (tenant_id, status, decided_at).

Add createStateSnapshotRepository (create idempotent on snapshot_id, get tenant-scoped, list deterministic by created_at, snapshot_id) and createDecisionRepository (create idempotent on decision_id returning {created:false,id} on re-post, get tenant-scoped, list with optional class/status filters ordered by decided_at, decision_id, listEvaluated/listAwaiting for live calibration) behind createRepositories as snapshots and decisions; all SQL binds tenant_id; no update or delete surface; calibration counts derive from stored record.evaluation fields.

Add POST /v1/snapshots (201 {snapshot_id}, 400 on bad body with {code,message} envelope), POST /v1/decisions (runs validateDecisionRecord then snapshots.get, 400 MISSING_STATE_SNAPSHOT or MISSING_DO_NOTHING or BAD_EVALUATION, 422 UNKNOWN_SNAPSHOT {code:UNKNOWN_SNAPSHOT} writing nothing, 201 {decision_id, status, expected_evaluation_at} with idempotent re-post returning the existing id), GET /v1/decisions?class=&status= (deterministic decided_at, decision_id order), GET /v1/decisions/:id (full record: alternatives, expected_outcomes, risk, evidence_refs, memory_refs, critic_result, policy_decision_id, model_versions, evaluation when present), GET /v1/calibration (LIVE aggregate precision, false_intervention_rate, evaluated, correct, interventions, needless, awaiting_maturity computed from the decisions repository via record.evaluation; rates are null when their denominator is zero). Unknown snapshot id is a 422; nothing executes; no route imports test fixtures.

Rewrite journal(): ideal renders a filter form (two native selects, action class and status, GET submit, labelled, keyboard operable) plus a table (When, Action class, Selected, Expected, Matured, Status with row counts and deterministic sort) where each row is a link/button opening the detail drawer; the drawer shows alternatives including the do-nothing entry with its reason, expected effect distributions (mean/p10/p90), downside estimate with worst-reasonable-case, evidence and memory refs, critic result, and policy decision id, plus a Close button returning focus to the invoking row; below the table a LIVE calibration summary panel reads the decisions repository and shows precision 1.00 over 2 matured, false-intervention 0.00 over 1 intervention, 1 awaiting maturity on seeded boot, and an em-dash for each rate when its denominator is zero (copy: Precision — (no matured evaluations yet)). Partial renders awaiting-maturity rows with expected evaluation dates (copy: Awaiting maturity — expected evaluation 25 Sept 2026). Error names the failed scenario (copy: Replay evaluation failed for scenario replay-tracking-outage. Every prior journal entry is preserved and untouched.) with a per-scenario Retry button. Empty keeps Shadow mode has not started copy and the Start the first replay link. Loading keeps skeleton rows with cached calibration and a refreshing indicator. Narrow widths collapse the table to cards and the drawer to a full-screen overlay per docs/ui.md. The page never reads the frozen replay fixture.

Add drawer behaviour: opening a journal row fetches the detail endpoint content into the drawer region, moves focus into the drawer, announces via the aria-live region, and Close/Escape returns focus to the invoking row; filter selects submit natively with no JS required.

After the existing journey events, write one state snapshot (state_seed_1) then three decisions through the new repositories with fixed ids for idempotent re-seeding: dec_seed_matured_1 (budget-change intervention decided 150h ago, full alternatives and critic/policy ids, evaluation {outcome:correct, needless:false}) + dec_seed_donothing_1 (campaign-status do-nothing decided 150h ago with reason qualified CPL within 15% of target; no frontier move beats holding spend, evaluation {outcome:correct, needless:false}) + dec_seed_awaiting_1 (budget-change intervention decided 6h ago, no evaluation, expected evaluation +120h). Live totals this produces: evaluated=2, correct=2, precision 1.00; interventions=1, needless=0, false-intervention 0.00; awaiting=1.

Replay failure fixture replay-broken references a missing snapshot to exercise per-scenario retry preserving prior entries.

work_order.understanding: Issue #19 is the shadow-mode slice of epic #14: before any spend moves, the system records what it would do with predicted impact in a decision journal, evaluates predictions at maturity, and reports calibration (precision, false-intervention rate). The contract face is the decision record (immutable StateSnapshot reference, do-nothing alternative, expected distributions, downside, evidence/memory refs, critic result, policy id, evaluation scheduled at maturity); the UI face is the /journal page (filterable table, detail drawer, live calibration summary, all five states). Dependencies #17 (measurement) and #18 (Meta read) are done, so maturity math and provider patterns exist to reuse; the binding epic #14 answer fixes Meta-first ordering. v2 was rejected because the live panel (computed from the decisions repository, which held 3 seed rows with no evaluation-outcome field) and the QA script (precision 0.70 over 10 matured from the frozen replay) named two different data sources as one; v3 takes rejection option (a) live-truth: the record gains an evaluation outcome, the seed writes evaluated outcomes producing 1.00/0.00 live rates, the frozen 0.70 aggregate stays CI-only under test/ and never reaches the page, and every live sentence names the repository.
